title: Dynamic web-agent reliability
why: Tests whether reobservation/pixel guards stop stale browser clicks and whether retries undo an already-achieved goal.
mechanism: Evaluation/reliability of browser-agent perception–action loop: late-swap policies (reactive vs reobserve vs pixel guard vs onlooker) on stale UI actions and achieved-goal reversals under one owned UI state machine; frozen AgentHijack-Agent checkpoint
evaluation_signal: Author-reported 96 main + 18 supplementary real-model branches; late-swap table (reobserve/pixel guard 6/6 first-dispatch correct, 3/6 final; reactive/onlooker 0/6 with 6 stale clicks). Offline reproduce.py rederives tables from canonical traces without inference. Bounded local UI — not multi-site CI.
evidence_locator: README main findings table; docs/ORIGINAL_RESULTS.txt; results/policy_condition_summary.csv and RESULT_TABLE.md; CITATION.cff; PUBLICATION.md
retrieval_notes: No arXiv/DOI. Repo created 2026-10-24T10:33Z (before prior collect af1658c but not previously inbox'd). Opened README, CITATION.cff, PUBLICATION.md, contents of results/ and docs/.
